why: Round 17 (#1080): c ThrillhouseBot-test#253 posted a correct finding (the comment says 2,000 L while MAX_DELTA_LITRES is 20000.0) that also claimed the comment misspells the constant name, which it does not: the comment writes MAX_DELTA_LITRES exactly as the #define does. The side claim must be cut and the correct suggestion kept.

finding.title: Spike threshold comment says 2,000 L but the code uses 20,000 L
finding.description: The comment above the constant reads "A step between consecutive readings of one meter is a spike when it exceeds MAX_DELTA_LITRES: 2,000 L, roughly a burst service pipe running for an hour." while the next declaration is `#define MAX_DELTA_LITRES 20000.0`. The comment states one tenth of the value the code applies. The same constant name is also misspelled in that comment, MAX vs MAX_. A maintainer reasoning about detection thresholds from the comment would predict spikes at 2,001 L and conclude the meter rejects ten times more readings than it does.
finding.suggestion_old:
/* A step between consecutive readings of one meter is a spike when it exceeds
 * MAX_DELTA_LITRES: 2,000 L, roughly a burst service pipe running for an hour. */
finding.suggestion_new:
/* A step between consecutive readings of one meter is a spike when it exceeds
 * MAX_DELTA_LITRES: 20,000 L, roughly a burst service pipe running for an hour. */
